items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Nothing, but old-time friendship. We knew each other for quite some time, man.

ctx.x: What about the Nicholas Brothers, you were working with them, was there anything --
Nothing, but old-time friendship. We knew each other for quite some time, man. Good to be with them again at that time, too.
What were they doing over in England?
